rationale.intuition: Emory ED2 ~10% per real Emory CDS 2024-25 data (validated via PR #292 — see TIER_B notes). Overall admit 10.29%; ED1 23.23%; intl admit 6.33%. ED2 is materially weaker than ED1 (~half the boost) but still 1.5-2x RD intl. Pre-med biology profile (USABO semifinalist) aligns with Emory's pre-health strength. Industry: T20 ED2 intl-CN strong pre-med profile cluster 4-18%. This fixture validates ED2 path handling for intl pool (separate from ED1 boost calibration).

sources.name: Emory CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 10.29%; ED 23.23% (ED1+ED2 combined per CDS C21); intl admit 6.33%. Emory was a key data point in PR #292 ED2 schema update (hasEarlyDecision2 = true).

sources.name: PR #292 ED2 Validation Notes (2026-05-22)
